frozen_diagnostic_rules.baron_recovery: PCGrad-minus-joint primary Baron recall positive in every seed and fixed-seed mean conditional95 interval above zero.
frozen_diagnostic_rules.interpretation: Passing is an exploratory candidate only, not breakthrough, deployment, novelty or confirmatory evidence. Negative outcomes retained. No equivalence claim from interval overlap. No clinically/practically justified noninferiority margin yet; no confirmatory test authorized.
frozen_diagnostic_rules.macro_gain: PCGrad-minus-joint primary macro positive every seed and mean conditional95 interval above zero.
frozen_diagnostic_rules.no_mean_task_harm: All three event mean primary recall differences versus joint >=0; also show each event/seed/region and secondary interval regardless.
frozen_diagnostic_rules.practical_screen: All preceding rules AND every PCGrad primary event/region/seed burden <=1. Report all comparator budget violations explicitly; a comparator failure does not excuse PCGrad failure.
frozen_diagnostic_rules.strong_control_gain: Primary macro mean conditional95 intervals above zero versus both independent encoders and TCN; report all seed signs.

implementation: Three-task Gram-matrix equivalent of literal vector projections, verified numerically. Separate per-shard NumPy projection RNG seeded [batch_shuffle_seed,20261002]; does not consume torch dropout RNG or batch-shuffle RNG. Original task-head updates. AdamW unchanged.
intervention: PCGrad (Yu et al. 2020 Algorithm 1) on all shared parameters. Independently random order of the other tasks per task per minibatch; project against original weighted task gradients; sum projected shared gradients. Task heads retain the original summed gradients. No change to original event weights 1/2/2.5, targets, architecture or policies. No gradient normalization, learning-rate tuning, clipping or search.
mechanism_limits: PCGrad changes both gradient direction and magnitude under AdamW. A gain cannot uniquely identify gradient conflict, loss scaling or representation interference as the cause. A failure rejects this intervention at this fixed budget, not every conflict-mitigation method. No causal claim from near-zero average cosine.
multiplicity: Exploratory unadjusted intervals for all contrasts; report full inventory without selecting a winning endpoint. No confirmatory significance or first-ever claim.
next_decision: Complete and analyse this bounded mechanistic study before selecting any further model or opening any new data.
normalization: Reuse identical train-current-frame moments; verify recomputed normalizer equals control.
policy: Original early-only 101-point threshold selection, 60s cooldown, one-to-one chronological credit, <=1 false-plus-late per match per event per region. Report both10-30 primary and20-60 secondary. Do not select thresholds or models on later calibration.
primary_diagnostic_contrast: PCGrad minus ordinary joint LeagueEWS in Baron timely recall at 10-30 seconds. Original registered LeagueEWS-minus-GRU macro primary remains unchanged.
prior_work: https://proceedings.neurips.cc/paper/2020/file/3fe78a8acf5fda99de95303940a2420c-Paper.pdf; applying PCGrad is established method use, not a new method.
publication: Aggregate results, code, protocol and hashes only. Private match arrays, predictions and model binaries remain excluded.
purpose: Test whether established shared-gradient conflict mitigation can recover Baron advance warning without concealing harm to Dragon or teamfight, after the shared-versus-independent tradeoff.
resources: Same 1751647 active parameters as joint LeagueEWS, three task backward passes per minibatch and one optimizer update. Matched examples/updates/capacity, not equal wall-clock compute. Independent control is three encoders per seed.
selection_evidence: Training-only diagnostics: other event gradients oppose Baron in 42-48% of final-checkpoint batches; mean pairwise cosine near zero and raw joint ascent only 0-2%. Early calibration shows burden and timing effects too. Conflict mitigation is plausible to test, not an established cause.
source_compatibility: Verify every original source against preserved GPU checkout. In current checkout permit only pinned scripts/run_three_event_trees.py formatting repair, requiring AST identity. Archive exporter sources remain byte-identical.
test_access: Patch16.17 prohibited, League development ZIP only.
training: Three seeds, all 48 train shards for 12 epochs =1728 updates, same 704967 rows/epoch, batch256, 8 observed frames, all 12 binary outputs, fixed final epoch. Checkpoint after every shard with model, optimizer and CPU/CUDA RNG. No scoring until all three fits complete.
uncertainty: 2000 whole-match bootstrap draws stratified by route, seed 20261001, paired across events and fitted seeds; conditional on fitted models/policies. Report each seed and fixed-seed average; do not multiply sample size by seeds.
